svg.title: trade-bot-hyperliquid-perp — decision matrix
svg.desc:
trade-bot-hyperliquid-perp — decision matrix Market name on every call; settings passed in; the plugin does not read trade-desk.yaml States shown: Live. Solid lines: data flows today.
Blocks, left to right: - Caller arguments: Market name (e.g. BTC); Contract address (rejected); Need not be a saved asset (this node or any chain); Interval; Candle count; analysisType id (one of fifteen); Mode (dry-run / backtest / live); momentum switch (optional, default off); candlestick switch (optional, default off) - Resolve and analyse: Search the live perp list; Starts with 0x: error, pass the name; Unknown or ambiguous: fail with candidates; Fetch Hyperliquid OHLCV; Run the named analysisType; Read the strong PRIMARY idea - Switch gate: momentum on: idea same side and clear; candlestick on: idea same side and clear; Both on: both must confirm; On and not confirming (do nothing, including no close) - Decision: No position + strong PRIMARY: open; Same direction: do nothing; Opposite direction: close; No clear idea: do nothing Lines: - Caller arguments -> Resolve and analyse - Resolve and analyse -> Switch gate - Switch gate -> Decision Note: Two things to keep in view. Settings arrive in analysisSettings on each call, so editing Host YAML trade-desk.yaml changes later runs. An open or a close returns an unsigned multi-sign payload for the agent; dry-run and backtest never do.
